title: xAI reportedly to spend $18B+ on Nvidia GPUs for Colossus 2

sources.quote: The purchase is expected to set back the company at least $18 billion, a sum that doesn’t include related equipment such as servers.

explain: The Wall Street Journal reported that xAI would buy about 300,000 Nvidia AI chips for its Colossus 2 data center in Memphis, costing at least $18B. The figure comes from an unnamed source; reports said the chips would be bought through a financing vehicle that leases them to xAI.
